subject: quantitative_aptitude
question: A bucket is in the form of a frustum of a right circular cone. The radii of its top and bottom circular ends are 28 cm and 7 cm respectively, and its vertical depth is 20 cm. What is the total surface area of sheet metal required to manufacture this bucket (having a closed circular base and an open top)? (Use π = 22/7)
explanation: Slant height l = sqrt(h^2 + (R - r)^2) = sqrt(20^2 + (28 - 7)^2) = sqrt(400 + 21^2) = sqrt(400 + 441) = sqrt(841) = 29 cm. Curved surface area of frustum = π (R + r) l = (22 / 7) × (28 + 7) × 29 = (22 / 7) × 35 × 29 = 22 × 5 × 29 = 110 × 29 = 3,190 cm^2. Area of closed bottom circular base = π r^2 = (22 / 7) × 7 × 7 = 154 cm^2. Total metal sheet area required = Curved Surface Area + Base Area = 3,190 + 154 = 3,344 cm^2.
